data.fund_name: Aditya Birla Sun Life CRISIL 10 Year Gilt ETF
data.fund_type: An open ended Debt Exchange Traded Fund tracking the CRISIL 10 Year Gilt Index. A relatively high interest rate risk and relatively low credit risk.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate returns corresponding to the total returns of the securities as represented by the CRISIL 10 Year Gilt Index before expenses, subject to tracking errors. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Government Securities - 95 to 100% T-Bills, cash and cash equivalent - 0 to 5%
